opportunities.title: Hakluyt Society Research Grants

amount.raw: Reimbursements of expenditure previously agreed with the relevant series editors (no amount stated)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants undertaking research in preparation of publication proposals for the Society, or research on approved projects under contract. Recipients of support need not be members of the Society. Applications under (A) go to the Society's Administrator; under (B) to the relevant Series Editor.
opportunities.summary: Research support from the Harry & Grace Smith Fund to reimburse agreed research expenditure in (A) preparing publication proposals to be submitted to the Society, or (B) research towards completion of publication projects approved by the Society and under contract. Payments are made as reimbursements of expenditure previously agreed with the relevant series editors.
